name: Michael Kirk Jameson
prior_offices: Big Horn County coroner (won the November 2022 general election and was re-elected in 2026)
background: Michael Kirk Jameson, also listed as Mike Jameson, is the Big Horn County coroner and was re-elected in the November 2026 general election. The Lovell Chronicle reported that he won the August 2026 Republican primary with 2,837 votes over Clayton Draggoo and then ran unopposed in the general election.
